key_insight: SynDebug brings debugging into fault-tolerant quantum computing by adding lightweight assertion-based checks directly inside encoded QEC workflows, not just at the logical circuit level.
engineering_relevance: It gives FTQC developers a practical way to catch logic bugs with minimal overhead, supporting more reliable large-scale quantum software and system integration.
method: Introduces assertion-based debugging primitives for encoded FTQC executions
Targets realistic QEC infrastructures without adding extra logical surface area
Supports debugging across multiple code families, distances, and encoded workloads
evidence_signal: Across state preparation, entanglement validation, and Shor-style programs, SynDebug averaged 1.8% added circuit depth overhead, was 0% in most cases, and showed no measurable increase in logical error rate.
watch_item: The main concern is whether the framework remains equally lightweight and easy to integrate as FTQC stacks grow more heterogeneous and operationally complex.
paper_title: SynDebug: A Framework to Debug Logic Bugs in Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing Programs
